Markermd Filter Condition

markermd_filter_condition.Rd

S7 class representing a single filter condition. Each condition maps to one q2r predicate: a node-type test (is(<pandoc class>)) or one of the attribute/content helpers (has_class(), has_id(), has_text(), has_label(), has_option(), has_engine()).

Usage

markermd_filter_condition(
  type = character(0),
  value = character(0),
  negate = FALSE
)

Arguments

type

Character. The condition type. Must be one of the values returned by get_allowed_filter_condition_types().

value

Character. The condition value. For "node type" this must be a node kind from get_allowed_node_types() (excluding "Any node"); for "has option" it is a Quarto cell option as written on a #| line ("eval" for key presence, "eval: false" for a key/value test); for "has engine" it is a cell engine name (e.g. "r"); for the other types it is the class name, id, regex pattern, or glob pattern.

negate

Logical. When TRUE the predicate is negated (logical NOT).

Examples

# Match divs
type_condition = markermd_filter_condition(
  type = "node type",
  value = "Div"
)

# Match nodes carrying a class
class_condition = markermd_filter_condition(
  type = "has class",
  value = "hint"
)
